supported: ODF1.3 first/stored mimetype, complete manifest, content.xml automatic styles
bold italic underline strike code text and safe absolute links
bounded ordered/bullet nested lists <=9, per-container start
rectangular v1 rich text tables and alignments
authorized original PNGs with original digest/bytes, alt/caption and explicit 96dpi sizing
